summary: Affected-site error fell from 6-18 percentage points to under 1 point in every development fold. Healthy-site average errors also decreased.
decision: Use a local readout and balanced local examples for the repair. Verify continued learning and fresh-world accuracy before adoption, then repair action forecasts. No restart from scratch is indicated by this diagnostic.

measurement.text: Errors are absolute differences on the normalized function index expressed as percentage points, averaged separately over affected and healthy sites. Original affected-site errors: 6.1-18.3 points. Local readout: 0.10-0.74 points. Worst individual all-channel error still reaches 12.7 points.

review_notes: All eight tests left one development world out of the fitted readout. These are development folds, not fresh physics confirmation.
The encoder remained frozen; no original self-module weight changed. This supports decoder/training repair over rebuilding the representation from scratch.
The alternative using the shared body belief did not improve healthy-site error in every world. Keep the local-only result distinct.
No future outcome is predicted by this readout.
